scope: Refresh the optional open-source ACIS semantic-reader route against the current published cq-acis release; keep parser, kernel, extracted payload, DWG AcDs graph, and native consumer evidence independent.

method.kind: Primary-source PyPI attestation/release metadata and project documentation, reconciled with existing repository plans and generated witness recipe
method.evidenceBoundary: PyPI directly reports a verified publication attestation and hashes for the release artifacts. Project documentation describes capability boundaries but was not audited file-by-file at the attested e05a8f4 source tree in this pass. Neither release availability nor documentation establishes behavior on the target SAB, native producer semantics, DWG AcDs linkage, or independent-kernel agreement.

evidence.topic: Current cq-acis distribution provenance and host artifact
observed: PyPI lists cq-acis 0.3.12 released on 2026-10-16 and verifies a GitHub Actions publish attestation from repository monozukuri-ai/cq-acis at commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889.
The macOS ARM64 wheel SHA-256 is 94204f623d752e7dacf494bf631551277a985acbeb612ee3a24464ea0f0daab5.
The release also lists Windows x86-64, Linux manylinux x86-64 and ARM64, and macOS x86-64 wheels.
doesNotEstablish: the 0.3.12 runtime result on any local or target SAB/DWG
that a prior 0.3.8 or 0.3.11 result reproduces on 0.3.12
source-tree equality between mutable main documentation and the attested release tree without a pin-specific audit
evidence.planUse: Use 0.3.12/e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889 as the latest optional candidate pin only. Verify wheel digest and attestation, then audit the exact source tree before its one composed runtime check.

observed: The project documents experimental, bounded SAT/SAB/ASM support and selected analytic geometry conversions rather than arbitrary ACIS support.
Unknown entities may be preserved as raw records; unsupported referenced geometry causes conversion failure.
The SAB documentation describes history as an opaque retained suffix that is not validated/replayed and says parsed data does not establish current Inventor model state.
Detailed profile claims from mutable docs must be checked against the attested e05a8f4 release source before use.
doesNotEstablish: DWG ACDSDATA owner/key/prototype closure or history lifecycle
complete conversion of any specific target sample
AutoCAD producer units, dimensions, or current modeler state
evidence.planUse: Limit the candidate to an exact extracted SAT/SAB payload. Require full expected-body/reference coverage, explicit raw/diagnostic inventory, non-defaulted units, complete valid closed geometry, and independent analytic expectations; keep the outer DWG graph separate.

observed: acis-core describes a Rust-owned ACIS model/parser layer without a CadQuery dependency; cq-acis geometry conversion uses CadQuery/OpenCascade.
The previous pinned-source audit records consulted ezdxf and cadmpeg grammar/material, so parser code is distinct but format assumptions are not wholly uncorrelated.

The corpus README pins source revisions and licenses and includes NIST and ezdxf cases, but those files do not provide the target AutoCAD producer/dimension evidence; do not copy its data into this repository.
doesNotEstablish: an independent geometry kernel from FreeCAD's OCCT family
that an upstream corpus license grants this repository redistribution rights
evidence.planUse: Classify cq-acis as an independent parser route grouped with OCCT-derived geometry results, not as a second kernel. Preserve source/parser/kernel/corpus/consumer lineage and use only existing locally generated controls in this repository.

observed: A platform wheel is available, but the package requires Python 3.11+ and CadQuery/OCCT runtime dependencies.
The repository already has a locally authored asymmetric ACIS-218/SAB witness recipe and independent analytic expectations; no committed drawing binary is needed for a first candidate check.
evidence.planUse: Do not install or run the peer per code slice. At one composed checkpoint use an isolated environment with exact artifact/dependency pins, first run the local analytic SAB, and run previously hash-pinned external SABs only if already available and provenance-reviewed. Keep all external outputs outside the repository; report NOT_RUN when unavailable.

nextActions: At the single composed ACIS checkpoint, verify the 0.3.12 artifact hash/attestation and inspect the exact e05a8f4 release source/profile before runtime use.
Use the locally generated analytic ACIS-218/SAB witness first; require complete body/reference coverage, explicit diagnostics/raw records, known units, and independent analytic bounds/area/volume.
Keep exact DWG entity-to-AcDs owner/key/prototype/history linkage in a separate evidence lane; an extracted-payload parser cannot close it.
Do not add peer dependencies or downloaded fixture files; do not run this comparator during per-slice validation.
Keep all six external-only J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
